answer: A farm that owns the submitting key cannot also own the verifiers, since each one must be independent on the glacier graph and each exposes its bond to the timber slash if it rubber-stamps. Since disagreement burns everyone the epoch, the quartz audit records every split and the operator cannot buy agreement cheaply. A verdict only settles when 2 independent verifiers reach the same tier, and the payout is withheld until they do. That is 6 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
